title: Mild primary PPH from uterine atony, stable vitals — responds to first-response bundle
scenario_note: Milder atony case: EBL ~650 mL, warning-band physiology absent, full resources available at a secondary hospital. Tests that the engine activates the pathway at the 500 mL threshold without over-escalating, sequences the first-response bundle correctly, and does not recommend transfer when the patient is stable and responsive to initial measures. SYNTHETIC DATA ONLY.

bleeding.visible_lacerations: small first-degree perineal tear, not actively bleeding

input.free_text_intake: Blood loss about 650 mL since delivery 50 minutes ago. Uterus feels soft. Vitals stable. Small tear present but not bleeding.

risk_rationale: EBL 650 mL >= 500 mL after vaginal birth = PPH (activate pathway)
Shock index 0.83 in normal obstetric range; no red vital signs
EBL < 1000 mL and hemodynamically stable = mild/minor PPH (RCOG minor 500-1000 mL)
Uterine atony is the most likely 4T cause (soft uterus); laceration not bleeding
missing_info: time_of_birth_exact (TXA window verification — ~50 min given, well inside 3 h; confirm clock time)

first_5_prioritized_actions.action: Notify team and assign roles (PPH diagnosed); begin timed response and quantitative blood-loss tracking.
Uterine (fundal) massage — uterus soft; stimulate contraction and reassess tone.
Oxytocin 10 IU IM or IV SLOW (treatment dose; first-line uterotonic). Never rapid IV push.
Tranexamic acid 1 g (100 mg/mL) IV over 10 minutes — within 3 h of birth.
Confirm patent IV access and start isotonic crystalloid infusion; monitor vitals and blood loss every 5-15 minutes.

blocked_or_flagged.note: Stable vitals, full resources on site, SI normal — do NOT over-escalate; reassess after first-response bundle. Escalate only if bleeding continues 15-30 min after bundle (esc-refractory-bundle) or SI crosses 0.9.
BP 118/72 documented and no hypertensive disorder — gate G4 passes; reserve for second line if oxytocin fails.

escalation_expected.action: No immediate transfer. Continue monitoring per pathway; if bleeding persists 15-30 minutes after first-response bundle, activate refractory bundle on site (secondary hospital has full resources).
